research.summary: Ghost is a Node.js-based headless CMS and publishing platform. The vendor publishes a single page documenting end-of-life per major version; there is no API or structured feed.
research.notes: The vendor's End of Life column is month-precision (e.g. Jan 2019); no day is published, so eol is stored as YYYY-MM and never padded. Ghost 6.x EOL is TBC (null). Released years are year-only, so ga stays null. Month-precision EOL excludes these records from the day-precision OpenEoX export, where they are enumerated under v1/openeox/index.json exclusions.
